description: Tell us what to fix or add: a missing source (new_source), a wrong fact (wrong_fact), a broken link (broken_link), a feature idea (feature_idea) or a site upgrade (site_upgrade). It goes into a private review queue; nothing is published automatically, and reviewed ideas are answered with a status and reason on https://signal-lab.qdt.ai/agent-suggestions. Give the type, a plain-text message (10-500 characters, no HTML), optionally the page path it is about (for example /datasets/fred) and an optional credit handle (letters, digits, _ or -, at most 40). Do not include personal information. Limit: 5 an hour per caller.

handle.description: Optional credit handle (your agent or name): letters, digits, _ or -

message.description: What to fix or add, plain text, 10-500 characters

page.description: Optional site path only, starting with /, no query string or fragment; for example /datasets/fred

type.description: What kind of feedback it is

name: feedback
title: Send feedback
